_comment: Copy to var/data/models.json. Each stage takes one model or an ordered list (a chain).
Spec: [provider:]model[@effort]. Providers: zai (default, GLM key), codex (codex login), claude (claude login).
The first model answers; the next one is used only while the previous one fails with QUOTA/AUTH/TRANSIENT,
and the preferred model is probed again after 5m/15m (transient) or 6h (quota/auth). Never on a bad answer.
Stages: news.screen (candidate selection), news.first_pass (first analysis), news.confirm (final analysis when
needs_confirmation says so). Unknown ids are rejected at load time; run tools/check_api_keys.py to verify.
Object form for the confirm stage: {"model": "codex:gpt-5.6-sol", "effort": "high", "transport": "direct"}
Single-model stages (exactly one, no chain): paper.decide (PAPER opportunity rotation), quant.rotation_entry
(hyundai rotation -> Quant). Changing them requires tools/install_product_gate.py install --force-routing + issue --reissue.
